verdict.rationale: Vapi is built API-first: assistants, tools, dynamic variables, hooks, and call behavior are all configurable via API/SDK, and Vapi ships a CLI (vapi-docs-2,31,32) and an official MCP server (vapi-docs-5,33,37) that exposes 'assistants, phone numbers, and calls' management to any AI agent, strongly supporting API/UI parity for core workflows. However, several settings are explicitly documented as dashboard-only actions — HIPAA compliance is 'ensured by turning on HIPAA compliance in the Dashboard' (vapi-docs-10) and Voice Library browsing/preview is dashboard-based (vapi-docs-8,35) — indicating some administrative/enterprise features are not fully API-parallel. Missing for 10: explicit API endpoints for HIPAA/enterprise toggles, confirmation that SSO/RBAC config is API-settable, and independent verification of full CLI/API-UI feature parity beyond docs claims.
